descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de electrocasnice, electrice și electronice, Servicii IT și consultanță IT și Dezvoltare de software
Miele Tehnica is a subsidiary of Miele & Cie. KG, Germany. We produce electronic components for a wide range of Miele appliances, such as washing machines, tumble dryers, vacuum cleaners, ovens and others. The products Miele offers to its customers set the standards for durability, performance, ease of use, energy efficiency, design and service.
 As part of the Business Unit Professional IT , we develop and operate digital solutions that support Miele's professional products and services. By combining modern frontend technologies, cloud-native architectures, and enterprise integrations, we create seamless digital experiences that connect customers, products, and business systems.
 In this position, you will help shape Miele's next generation of digital platforms. Working closely with Product Owners, Software Engineers, DevOps Engineers, and Architects, you will build modern frontend applications, integrate enterprise platforms, and contribute to the evolution of a composable MACH architecture. Your work will directly influence the user experience across Miele's digital ecosystem.
 Key Responsibilities 
Design, develop, and optimize modern frontend applications using Vue.js and Nuxt.js .
Build and maintain integrations between Content Management, E-Commerce, ERP, CRM, and third-party systems.
Develop and extend headless CMS capabilities using Contentstack .
Build and maintain reliable CI/CD pipelines supporting automated deployments and release processes.
Collaborate with DevOps Engineers and Software Engineers to ensure scalable, secure, and high-performing digital solutions.
Contribute to the evolution of Miele's composable MACH platform architecture.
Support production environments by troubleshooting issues and continuously improving platform reliability.
Gradually take ownership of Shopify development, including theme customization, APIs, and smaller e-commerce projects.
 Required 
At least 3 years of professional frontend development experience .
Strong experience with JavaScript , TypeScript , Vue.js 3 and Nuxt.js 3 .
Experience developing production-grade web applications.
Experience integrating REST and GraphQL APIs.
Understanding of headless CMS platforms and API-driven architectures.
Familiarity with CI/CD workflows and Git-based development.
Knowledge of responsive web design, component-based architecture, and modern frontend best practices.
Strong analytical skills, ownership mentality, and collaborative mindset.
Good written and spoken English.
 Nice to Have 
Experience with Contentstack .
Experience with Shopify , Liquid, Storefront API, or Hydrogen.
Familiarity with MACH architecture and composable commerce.
Experience with GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps.
Knowledge of observability platforms such as Datadog, New Relic, or Sentry.
Experience with micro-frontends or module federation.
Experience with enterprise integration platforms such as MuleSoft or Azure Integration Services.
Knowledge of automated testing frameworks such as Jest, Vitest, Cypress, or Playwright.
Understanding of SEO, accessibility (WCAG), and Core Web Vitals.
German language skills.
 Technology Stack 
Vue.js 3
Nuxt.js 3
JavaScript / TypeScript
HTML5 / CSS3 / SCSS
Contentstack
Shopify
REST & GraphQL APIs
Git
GitHub Actions / GitLab CI / Azure DevOps
Docker
MACH Architecture
Microservices
Headless CMS
Composable Commerce
 Education 
 You have a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Web Development, or a related technical discipline—or equivalent professional experience in frontend development and enterprise integrations.
 Why Join Miele? 
Build digital platforms used by customers and business users around the world.
Work with modern frontend technologies and composable cloud architectures.
Help shape the future of Miele's digital ecosystem through innovative web and integration solutions.
Collaborate with international, cross-functional engineering teams.
Grow your career in a stable, innovative, and globally recognized company.
 If you are looking for a long-term career where your expertise is valued and where you can help build the next generation of digital platforms at Miele, we would be happy to welcome you to our team.
